articles.title: UP Woman Marries Lord Krishna in Vrindavan: Divine Devotion or Emotional Decision?
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 28-year-old woman from Badaun district in Uttar Pradesh, Pinky Sharma, has sparked nationwide discussion after she “married” Lord Shri Krishna in Vrindavan following traditional Hindu customs.

body.html:
A 28-year-old woman from Badaun district in Uttar Pradesh, Pinky Sharma, has sparked nationwide discussion after she “married” Lord Shri Krishna in Vrindavan following traditional Hindu customs. The symbolic ceremony, conducted by temple priests amid Vedic chants, has generated widespread curiosity and debate.

According to Pinky, she has been a staunch devotee of Lord Krishna since childhood and had pledged to dedicate her life to him. During the ceremony in Vrindavan, she wore a red saree, took the seven pheras, and even donned a mangalsutra, mirroring a traditional Hindu wedding.

Her father, Suresh Chand, stated that Pinky believed she received a divine sign when a ring fell into her hands along with prasad at the Banke Bihari temple. Interpreting it as Krishna’s acceptance, she asked her family to stop searching for a groom. The family respected her wish and supported the symbolic marriage.

Photos and videos of the ceremony are now going viral on social media. While many consider it an exceptional display of devotion, others view it as an emotional decision. Local residents and devotees remain intrigued by the unusual event, which continues to dominate public conversation.

A major ATM theft case from UP has been solved. Last night, thieves uprooted a PNB ATM in Moradabad, which was later found broken in a field in Amroha with nearly ₹7 lakh missing.

articles.title: or Cold-Blooded Murder? Shocking Allegations Against Woman Constable Expose a Deep Conspiracy
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: The mystery surrounding the death of Inspector Arun Kumar Rai in Jalaun, Uttar Pradesh, has intensified, with conflicting claims emerging over whether the incident was a s¥ic¡de or a planned murder.

body.html:
The mystery surrounding the death of Inspector Arun Kumar Rai in Jalaun, Uttar Pradesh, has intensified, with conflicting claims emerging over whether the incident was a s¥ic¡de or a planned murder. While the initial report labelled it as s¥ic¡de allegedly driven by harassment from woman constable Meenakshi Sharma, a fresh FIR filed by the inspector’s wife, Maya Rai, accuses Sharma of murder or conspiracy to murder.

Senior police officers continue to treat the case as s¥ic¡de, yet several circumstances have raised serious doubts. The inspector’s body was found inside a mosquito net, and no bullet from the 9mm pistol was recovered from the room.

Constable Meenakshi Sharma, now under intense questioning, had reportedly been in close contact with Inspector Rai since July 2024, when both were posted at the Konch police station in Jalaun. Their relationship is said to have continued even after their transfers to Orai and Kuthaund, with Sharma frequently visiting him.

Investigators have found that Meenakshi, who uses an iPhone, recently lost ₹3 lakh in a bet, allegedly funded by Inspector Rai. Departmental sources further claim she possessed private videos of the officer and used them to blackmail him. Rai had reportedly gifted her an iPhone worth ₹1.5 lakh and a diamond necklace valued at ₹3 lakh.

On Friday around 9 pm, Inspector Rai is said to have shot himself with his service revolver, the bullet striking his head. CCTV footage captured Meenakshi entering his residence shortly before the incident. Within three minutes of the gunshot, she was seen fleeing while talking on the phone. She informed the station staff, “Sir has shot himself,” before leaving the premises.

Rai, a native of Sant Kabir Nagar, joined the Uttar Pradesh Police as a constable in 1998. He became known for integrity and diligence, was promoted to sub-inspector in 2012, and rose to the rank of inspector in 2023. He was posted as the Station House Officer of Kuthaund in August 2025 and was known for being calm, approachable, and strict in duty.

Meenakshi’s wedding was scheduled for February 2026. She allegedly demanded ₹25 lakh from Rai to cover the entire wedding expenditure and threatened to reveal their private videos to his wife if he refused. She was found carrying three mobile phones and four SIM cards, while the inspector had three SIM cards. Police are examining call records, chat data, and recent absences from duty. The possibility of a third person’s involvement is also being investigated.

Inspector Rai’s wife, Maya Rai, broke down after seeing his body and was consoled by Orai CO Archana Singh, who described Rai as a positive and composed officer. His mortal remains were later taken to his native village Rajnauli in Sant Kabir Nagar.

Based on Maya Rai’s complaint, police have registered a murder case against Meenakshi Sharma. SP Durgesh Kumar stated that the investigation is in progress and assured strict action against all individuals found responsible.

articles.title: Goa Nightclub Inferno Exposes Shocking Illegal Operations; 25 Dead in Arpora Tragedy
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A massive fire erupted late on 6 December 2025 at the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Arpora, North Goa, claiming at least 25 lives. The deceased include 14 staff members, four tourists, and others who died primarily due to suffocation, while some sustained fatal burn injuries.

body.html:
A massive fire erupted late on 6 December 2025 at the Birch by Romeo Lane nightclub in Arpora, North Goa, claiming at least 25 lives. The deceased include 14 staff members, four tourists, and others who died primarily due to suffocation, while some sustained fatal burn injuries. Six people were injured. Rescue operations continued into Sunday morning.

Preliminary findings indicate the blaze may have been triggered by a gas cylinder explosion or sparks from overhead lighting during a performance. The fire spread rapidly due to highly flammable materials, including dry palm leaves used in temporary structures within the premises.

Multiple videos circulating on social media captured the unfolding chaos. One clip shows flames erupting from the ceiling during a dance act as panicked patrons search for exits. Another video shows the entire structure engulfed in a “fireball,” followed by visuals of complete devastation after the flames were doused. These visuals highlight severe overcrowding, narrow access lanes that delayed fire tenders, and the horizontal spread of the fire along the club’s ceiling.

An FIR for culpable homicide has been registered at Anjuna police station against the club’s owners, Saurabh Luthra and Gaurav Luthra, along with unnamed partners, managers, event organisers, and staff members. Authorities noted the absence of fire safety equipment, emergency exits, and valid operational licences. Arpora-Nagoa panchayat sarpanch Roshan Redkar was arrested for allegedly issuing an unauthorised trade licence in 2013 despite violations. Four managers have been detained, and three senior government officials, including the former Panchayat Director, were suspended for permitting operations.

Investigations revealed that the nightclub was functioning without a fire NOC, had narrow entry and exit points, poor ventilation, and used highly combustible materials. The structure was also constructed illegally on backwaters, with an earlier demolition notice reportedly stayed. Initial probes confirmed that the fire originated in the basement before spreading to the crowded upper floors.

Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant ordered a magisterial inquiry and assured strict action against those responsible. The state government announced financial assistance of Rs 5 lakh for the families of the deceased.

articles.title: Lucknow: Builder Marries Girlfriend to Escape Rape Case, Then Brutally Assaults Her With Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A disturbing case has surfaced in Lucknow, where a builder allegedly married his girlfriend to avoid arrest in a rape case and later assaulted her along with his family. The woman and her mother sustained serious injuries.

body.html:
A disturbing case has surfaced in Lucknow, where a builder allegedly married his girlfriend to avoid arrest in a rape case and later assaulted her along with his family. The woman and her mother sustained serious injuries. Chinhat police have registered a case against the accused builder, Satpal Singh, and his family, and an investigation is underway.

According to the complaint, Satpal Singh had been in contact with the woman for a long time. After she lodged a rape case and other serious charges at the Sushant Golf City police station, and Satpal feared arrest, he hastily married her at the Arya Samaj Temple in Aliganj on 28 May 2025. Despite the marriage being officially registered on 4 June, he did not take his wife home. It is also alleged that he hid the fact that he was already married. The woman repeatedly expressed her wish to live with her in-laws, but Satpal kept delaying it.

On the evening of 2 December, Satpal called her, saying the family would discuss the matter and she would be taken home. However, when she reached the Ashraf Vihar residence, the situation turned violent.

The complaint states that Satpal, his father Girish Kumar Singh, mother Pankaj Singh, sister Richa Singh, sister-in-law Satyavati alias Anju Singh, and servant Atul Singh assaulted her. They allegedly attempted to strangle her and kill her. When the woman’s mother intervened, she too was brutally beaten. Both suffered severe injuries.

During the assault, the woman managed to escape and called 112. Chinhat police reached the spot and admitted the mother and daughter to the hospital, where medical reports confirmed strangulation marks and multiple serious injuries.

The woman alleges that during the attack, the family members shouted, “Stay with the man you married… don’t come home.” She also claims they threatened to kill both of them and end the old case.

Police arrived after a video of the incident went viral on social media. The police say the viral video, medical reports and other evidence are part of the investigation. A case has been registered against Satpal Singh and his family under serious sections.
